assaultoverload.name: Assault Overload
assaultoverload.desc: Tribute 1 "/Assault Mode" monster. Inflict damage to both players equal to its Level x 200.

backupsecretary.name: Backup Secretary
backupsecretary.desc: If you control a Cyberse monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Backup Secretary" once per turn this way.

beetrooperscoutbuggy.name: Beetrooper Scout Buggy
beetrooperscoutbuggy.desc: You cannot Special Summon monsters, except Insect monsters. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Beetrooper Scout Buggy" from your hand, Deck, or GY. You can only use this effect of "Beetrooper Scout Buggy" once per turn.

darkmambele.name: Dark Mambele
darkmambele.desc: If you control 3 or more DARK monsters: Target 1 face-up card on the field; banish that target.

datatoken.name: Data Token
datatoken.desc: Summoned by the effect of "Link Streamer".

deepdiver.name: Deep Diver
deepdiver.desc: At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card was destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Choose 1 monster from your Deck and place it on top of your Deck.

dianathelightspirit.name: Diana the Light Spirit
dianathelightspirit.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 LIGHT monster from your GY. Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: Gain 1000 LP.

elshaddollapkallone.name: El Shaddoll Apkallone
elshaddollapkallone.desc:
2 "Shaddoll" monsters with different Attributes
Must first be Fusion Summoned. Cannot be destroyed by battle. You can only use each of the following effects of "El Shaddoll Apkallone" once per turn.
● If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 face-up card on the field; negate its effects.
● If this card is sent to the GY: You can add 1 "Shaddoll" card from your Deck or GY to your hand, then discard 1 card.

elvennotesoraclealicetea.name: Elvennotes ~Oracle Alicetea~
elvennotesoraclealicetea.desc: You cannot activate the following effects of "Elvennotes ~Oracle Alicetea~" in the same Chain. Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster you control; move that monster you control to another of your Main Monster Zones. When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card and you control 3 or more "Elvennotes" monsters: You can negate that effect, then if you control a Synchro Monster, you can destroy that card. You can only use this effect of "Elvennotes ~Oracle Alicetea~" once per turn.

exhaustingspell.name: Exhausting Spell
exhaustingspell.desc: Remove all Spell Counters on both sides of the field.

faoffroadgrandprix.name: F.A. Off-Road Grand Prix
faoffroadgrandprix.desc:
Increase the Levels of all "F.A." monsters on the field by 2 during the Main Phase only. You can only use each of the following effects of "F.A. Off-Road Grand Prix" once per turn.
● When a "F.A." monster you control is destroyed by battle: You can discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand.
● If this face-up card on the field is destroyed by a card effect: You can add 1 "F.A." card from your Deck to your hand, except "F.A. Off-Road Grand Prix".

fiveheadedlinkdragon.name: Five-Headed Link Dragon
fiveheadedlinkdragon.desc:
5 monsters
Must be Link Summoned. If this card is Link Summoned using DARK, EARTH, WATER, FIRE, and WIND Attributes: You can destroy all cards your opponent controls. Cannot be destroyed by battle with a DARK, EARTH, WATER, FIRE, or WIND monster. Unaffected by other cards' effects. Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: You must banish 5 cards from your GY face-down (this is not optional), or send this card to the GY.

gianttraphole.name: Giant Trap Hole
gianttraphole.desc: When 2 or more monsters are Special Summoned at the same time: Destroy all monsters on the field.

gimmickpuppetfiendishknight.name: Gimmick Puppet Fiendish Knight
gimmickpuppetfiendishknight.desc: If this card is in your hand: You can target 1 "Gimmick Puppet" monster in your GY or 1 monster in your opponent's GY; Special Summon it to its owner's field in Defense Position, but its effects are negated, then Special Summon this card. If this card is sent to the GY, except from the hand: You can add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Gimmick Puppet Fiendish Knight" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate either of this card's effects, except "Gimmick Puppet" monsters.

hotreddragonarchfiendbane.name: Hot Red Dragon Archfiend Bane
hotreddragonarchfiendbane.desc:
1 Tuner + 1 non-Tuner DARK Dragon Synchro Monster
You can Tribute 1 monster, then target 1 "Red Dragon Archfiend" monster in your GY; Special Summon it. When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can Special Summon 2 Tuners with the same Level (1 from your Deck and 1 from your GY) in Defense Position. You can only use each effect of "Hot Red Dragon Archfiend Bane" once per turn.

infernohammer.name: Inferno Hammer
infernohammer.desc: When this card destroys your opponent's monster and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, you can select 1 face-up monster on your opponent's side of the field and flip it into face-down Defense Position.

keeperoftheshrine.name: Keeper of the Shrine
keeperoftheshrine.desc: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a Dragon monster. While this card is in your hand or GY, if a face-up Dragon monster on the field, except "Keeper of the Shrine", is sent to the GY by a card effect or because it was destroyed by battle: You can Special Summon this card, then, if that monster sent to the GY is a Normal Monster, you can add 1 Dragon Normal Monster from your GY to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Keeper of the Shrine" once per turn.

magicreflector.name: Magic Reflector
magicreflector.desc: Target 1 face-up Spell Card you control; place 1 counter on it. If it would ever be destroyed, remove the counter instead.

mechaphantombeastwarbluran.name: Mecha Phantom Beast Warbluran
mechaphantombeastwarbluran.desc: If this card is sent to the Graveyard for the Synchro Summon of a Machine-Type monster: Special Summon 1 "Mecha Phantom Beast Token" (Machine-Type/WIND/Level 3/ATK 0/DEF 0), also, for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon any other monsters, except WIND monsters. While you control a Token, this card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. You can Tribute 1 other "Mecha Phantom Beast" monster; increase this card's Level by 1. You can only use 1 "Mecha Phantom Beast Warbluran" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

melffyfenny.name: Melffy Fenny
melffyfenny.desc: If your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step), or if an opponent's monster targets this card for an attack: You can return this card to the hand, then you can Special Summon 1 Beast monster from your hand, except "Melffy Fenny". During your End Phase: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can only use each effect of "Melffy Fenny" once per turn.

mimighouldungeon.name: Mimighoul Dungeon
mimighouldungeon.desc: "Mimighoul" monsters you control that were not Normal or Special Summoned this turn gain ATK equal to their original DEF. Any player who controls a face-down monster cannot Normal Summon monsters, nor declare an attack with monsters that were Special Summoned this turn. During your Main Phase: You can add 1 "Mimighoul" monster from your Deck or GY to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Mimighoul Dungeon" once per turn.

mysticalrefpanel.name: Mystical Refpanel
mysticalrefpanel.desc: Activate only when a Spell Card that targets 1 player is activated. The effect of that Spell Card is applied to the other player instead.

ninjitsuartofsupertransformation.name: Ninjitsu Art of Super-Transformation
ninjitsuartofsupertransformation.desc: Activate this card by targeting 1 "Ninja" monster you control and 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; send them to the GY, then Special Summon 1 Dragon, Dinosaur, or Sea Serpent monster from your Deck whose Level is less than or equal to the combined original Levels of the sent monster(s). When this card leaves the field, banish that monster.

nohpunkogredance.name: Noh-P.U.N.K. Ogre Dance
nohpunkogredance.desc: Once per turn, when your opponent activates a monster effect (Quick Effect): You can make this card gain ATK equal to that opponent's monster's original ATK until the end of this turn. You can only use each of the following effects of "Noh-P.U.N.K. Ogre Dance" once per turn. You can Tribute 1 "P.U.N.K." monster; Special Summon this card from your hand. You can send this card from your hand or field to the GY; add 1 "P.U.N.K." monster from your Deck to your hand, except a Level 8 monster.

raptorwingstrike.name: Raptor Wing Strike
raptorwingstrike.desc: Shuffle 1 "Blackwing" monster you control into the Main Deck; add 1 "Blackwing" monster from your Deck to your hand.

royalwritoftaxation.name: Royal Writ of Taxation
royalwritoftaxation.desc: Activate only during your opponent's Standby Phase. Select 1 random card from your opponent's hand and look at it. Unless the selected card or a card with the same name is Normal Summoned or activated by the end of your next turn, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. If the selected card or a card with the same name is Normal Summoned or activated by the end of your next turn, you take 1000 damage.

ryugeend.name: Ryu-Ge End
ryugeend.desc: Your opponent cannot target "Ryu-Ge" monsters you control with card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Ryu-Ge End" once per turn. If a "Ryu-Ge" Pendulum Monster is in your field or face-up Extra Deck: You can shuffle 2 "Ryu-Ge" monsters from your hand, GY, and/or banishment into the Main Deck, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy it. If this card is destroyed: You can Set 1 non-Continuous "Ryu-Ge" Trap from your Deck, GY, or banishment.

scarrscoutofdarkworld.name: Scarr, Scout of Dark World
scarrscoutofdarkworld.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Add 1 Level 4 or lower "Dark World" monster from your Deck to your hand.

sharethepain.name: Share the Pain
sharethepain.desc: Tribute 1 monster; make your opponent Tribute 1 monster (for no effect).

steelogregrotto2.name: Steel Ogre Grotto #2
steelogregrotto2.desc: A mechanized iron doll with tremendous strength.

summonstorm.name: Summon Storm
summonstorm.desc: Pay 800 LP; Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower WIND monster from your hand. During your Main Phase, except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower WIND monster from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Summon Storm" once per turn.

tardyorc.name: Tardy Orc
tardyorc.desc: This card cannot attack the turn it is Normal Summoned.

thedragonthatdevoursthedogma.name: The Dragon that Devours the Dogma
thedragonthatdevoursthedogma.desc:
"Fallen of Albaz" + 1 LIGHT or DARK monster + 1 Effect Monster
While an "Ecclesia" monster is on the field or in either GY, this card gains 500 ATK, also it is unaffected by other cards' effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "The Dragon that Devours the Dogma" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: You can shuffle up to 2 cards from any GY(s) and/or banishment into the Deck. During the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was sent there this turn: You can add 1 "Dogmatika" or "Tri-Brigade" card from your Deck to your hand.

vampirickoala.name: Vampiric Koala
vampirickoala.desc: If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by battle with a monster: Gain LP equal to the battle damage inflicted.

vicvipertypel.name: Vic Viper Type-L
vicvipertypel.desc:
At the start of your Battle Phase: You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon 1 Machine monster from your hand.
● Send 1 Level 4 or lower LIGHT Machine monster from your Deck to the GY.
If this card is destroyed: You can target 1 LIGHT Machine monster in your GY; Special Summon it, and if you Special Summoned a monster with 1200 or less original ATK, it gains 1200 ATK. You can only use each effect of "Vic Viper Type-L" once per turn.

waterelement.name: Water Element
waterelement.desc: ''A sea-dwelling spirit that takes away sight by clouding the area in fog.''

xheadcannon.name: X-Head Cannon
xheadcannon.desc: A monster with a mighty cannon barrel, it is able to integrate its attacks. It attacks in many ways by combining and separating with other monsters.
